Speaking heads

Each character's approved head, sculpted to speak: opened along its painted mouth line, with a mouth cavity, teeth, a tongue and a jaw bone at the jaw joint, then reduced as the characters were (authoring mesh, then the game mesh). Left: the approved head at the same mesh level. Right: the speaking head.

Reference sheet

The registered paint sheet's side and front views, with the mouth planned on them: the lip line (where the lips part), the corners and the jaw's angle, the jaw joint, the jaw line (the mandible's underside: the jaw's weight is whole above it), where the mouth opens at the front, the cavity, the teeth and the tongue. The plan is drawn from the same numbers that sculpt the head (tools/speaking-heads/mouths.mjs).
